subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should Codex WebSocket and Unix upgrade establishment be treated as part of `appServer.requestTimeoutMs`, so a peer that has not completed HTTP Upgrade by that budget is closed with code 1006?
rationale: The code and proof support the fix, but this intentionally converts an existing indefinite-wait behavior into a configured fail-closed boundary that can stop unusually slow existing deployments.

options.title: Use the existing request budget
options.body: Approve the shared `requestTimeoutMs` deadline for TCP and Unix upgrades, preserving one operator-controlled timeout policy and accepting code 1006 for over-budget handshakes.

options.title: Add a separate connect budget
options.body: Require a separately documented handshake/connect timeout only if maintainers want control-plane requests and connection establishment to have distinct compatibility policies.

options.title: Retain indefinite upgrades
options.body: Decline the fail-closed behavior and keep current unbounded upgrade waits, leaving the reported hang unresolved.

recommendation.title: Use the existing request budget
recommendation.body: Approve the shared `requestTimeoutMs` deadline for TCP and Unix upgrades, preserving one operator-controlled timeout policy and accepting code 1006 for over-budget handshakes.
